title: Maraghei dialect
extract: Maraghei is a dialect of the Tati language, spoken in the Gilan Province, and upper Rudbar area. The Maraghei Tati is closely related to Talysh and Gozarkhani, and falls under the Central Tatic subgroup. One dialect spoken is Dikini, there are also various other dialects.
